description: Funds that raised in the last 24 months and are backing fintech rounds in the last 12: approved funds (not other-sector) whose latest first/interim/final close is within 24 months and whose manager invested in public equity rounds in the last 12 months (at least 1 for fintech funds, 2 for generalist or unknown focus). Per fund: manager, latest close, size or target as announced (never converted), rounds_12m, rounds_since_close and the 3 latest rounds. Optional filters apply to the qualifying rounds: topic (topic slug, via the news linked to the round), country (company's country slug), stage (pre-seed, seed, series-a, series-b, series-c-plus, growth — derived from round_type). limit ≤ 50. Unknown arguments are rejected.
name: list_deploying_funds
title: List funds deploying now
